name_story.story: Shabani can be understood through the Arabic form شَعْبَانُ, whose central sense is shabani; the month of sha'ban (swahili form). Shabani is the Swahili form of Arabic شَعْبَان (Shaʿbān), the name of a lunar month, used as a male given name.

faq.a: Shabani is associated with the Arabic form شَعْبَانُ, whose core sense is shabani; the month of sha'ban (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Shabani?
faq.a: Shabani is associated with Arabic. Shabani is the Swahili form of Arabic شَعْبَان (Shaʿbān), the name of a lunar month, used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form شَعْبَانُ is Arabic.
Shabani can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Shabani should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Shaʿbān is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Shabani mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Shabani is rendered شعبان and carries the sense شعبان، شعبان کا مہینہ.

faq.q: What does Shabani mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Shabani is rendered شعبان and carries the sense شعبان، ماه شعبان.
A romanized syllable approximation is sha-ba-ni. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Shabani?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Shabani, shabani. Script forms are شعبان, شَعْبَانُ, शाबान.

faq.q: Is Shabani a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
